newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares edge up in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares edge up in light trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares edged up slightly in light trade on Thursday, dealers said.
The group A index rose by 20.59 points to 2,364.24 in trade of just over one million litas.
Energy sector companies accounted for about a third of the session's turnover.
Lithuania Energy company rose to 2.80 litas from 2.50 litas and 214,000 litas worth of its shares changed hands.
Lithuania Gas remained unchanged at 2.00 litas in trade worth over 115,000 litas.
The Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company advanced to 7.10 litas from 6.58 litas in trade of 4,750 litas.
Shares in the Snaige refrigerator maker were in demand, with turnover reaching 140,000 litas and the price staying unchanged at 11.00 litas.
Snaige announced earlier this week that its net profit for 1996 was 624,000 litas after posting a 3.4 million litas loss the previous year.
Dealers say that the bourse should pick up steam in March after a spate of shareholders' meetings.
Block trades worth 940,000 litas were also made and the secondary T-bill market was active, turning over almost eight million litas.
